description: Erection of a single storey double garage in the rear garden of the flats
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (C01 A, C02 A, C03 A, C04 A, C05 A: Received 15/06/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The garage hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for parking purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwellings at 34 Thornbury Road, TW7 4LL, and not as primary residential accommodation or for business purposes, nor shall any bathroom or kitchen facilities be installed into the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
